import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class ModInt {
        static final long mod = 1000000007;
        long v;

        public ModInt() {
            this.v = 0;
        }

        public ModInt(long _v) {
            this.v = normS(_v % mod + mod);
        }

        private static long normS(long x) {
            return (x < mod) ? x : x - mod;
        }

        public static ModInt make(long x) {
            return new ModInt(x);
        }

        public ModInt plus(ModInt b) {
            return make(normS(this.v + b.v));
        }

        public ModInt minus(ModInt b) {
            return make(normS(this.v + mod - b.v));
        }

        public ModInt neg() {
            return make(normS(mod - this.v));
        }

        public ModInt times(ModInt b) {
            return make((this.v * b.v) % mod);
        }

        public ModInt div(ModInt b) {
            return this.times(b.inv());
        }

        public ModInt inv() {
            long[] xy = extgcd(this.v, mod);
            long x = xy[0], y = xy[1];
            return make(normS(x + mod));
        }

        public ModInt pow(long p) {
            if (p < 0) {
                return this.inv().pow(-p);
            }
            ModInt a = new ModInt(1);
            ModInt x = this;
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) {
                    a = a.times(x);
                }
                x = x.times(x);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return a;
        }

        private long[] extgcd(long a, long b) {
            long[] p = {a, 1, 0};
            long[] q = {b, 0, 1};
            while (q[0] != 0) {
                long t = p[0] / q[0];
                for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                    long temp = p[i] - t * q[i];
                    p[i] = q[i];
                    q[i] = temp;
                }
            }
            if (p[0] < 0) {
                for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                    p[i] = -p[i];
                }
            }
            return p;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return Long.toString(v);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object obj) {
            if (obj instanceof ModInt) {
                return this.v == ((ModInt) obj).v;
            }
            return false;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Long.hashCode(v);
        }
    }

    static class BitSet128 {
        long low;
        long high;

        public BitSet128() {
            this.low = 0L;
            this.high = 0L;
        }

        public void set(int i, boolean value) {
            if (i < 64) {
                if (value) {
                    low |= 1L << i;
                } else {
                    low &= ~(1L << i);
                }
            } else {
                if (value) {
                    high |= 1L << (i - 64);
                } else {
                    high &= ~(1L << (i - 64));
                }
            }
        }

        public boolean get(int i) {
            if (i < 64) {
                return ((low >> i) & 1L) != 0;
            } else {
                return ((high >> (i - 64)) & 1L) != 0;
            }
        }

        public BitSet128 clone() {
            BitSet128 b = new BitSet128();
            b.low = this.low;
            b.high = this.high;
            return b;
        }

        public boolean equals(Object obj) {
            if (obj instanceof BitSet128) {
                BitSet128 b = (BitSet128) obj;
                return this.low == b.low && this.high == b.high;
            }
            return false;
        }

        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(low, high);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        int N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        ModInt[][] p = new ModInt[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                p[i][j] = new ModInt(Long.parseLong(st.nextToken()));
                p[i][j] = p[i][j].div(new ModInt(100));
            }
        }

        Map<BitSet128, ModInt> cur = new HashMap<>();
        Map<BitSet128, ModInt> nxt = new HashMap<>();
        BitSet128 b = new BitSet128();
        b.set(0, true);
        cur.put(b, new ModInt(1));

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            nxt.clear();
            for (Map.Entry<BitSet128, ModInt> entry : cur.entrySet()) {
                BitSet128 bits = entry.getKey();
                ModInt sc = entry.getValue();

                List<Integer> ones = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int idx = 0; idx < (1 << N); idx++) {
                    if (bits.get(idx)) {
                        ones.add(idx);
                    }
                }

                for (int e = 0; e < (1 << N); e++) {
                    ModInt pr = new ModInt(1);
                    for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                        if (((e >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                            pr = pr.times(p[i][j]);
                        } else {
                            pr = pr.times(new ModInt(1).minus(p[i][j]));
                        }
                    }
                    BitSet128 nb = new BitSet128();
                    for (int x : ones) {
                        for (int r = 0; r < N; r++) {
                            if (((e >> r) & 1) == 1 && !bits.get(r)) {
                                BitSet128 temp = bits.clone();
                                temp.set(r, true);
                                nb = mergeBitSets(nb, temp);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    nxt.put(nb, nxt.getOrDefault(nb, new ModInt(0)).plus(sc.times(pr)));
                }
            }
            cur = new HashMap<>(nxt);
        }

        ModInt ans = new ModInt(0);
        int fullMask = (1 << N) - 1;
        for (Map.Entry<BitSet128, ModInt> entry : cur.entrySet()) {
            if (entry.getKey().get(fullMask)) {
                ans = ans.plus(entry.getValue());
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static BitSet128 mergeBitSets(BitSet128 a, BitSet128 b) {
        BitSet128 res = new BitSet128();
        res.low = a.low | b.low;
        res.high = a.high | b.high;
        return res;
    }
}
